resources.string: Retained records matching these filters, not lifetime totals
No retained connections match these filters. Recording is disabled; enable it in History to capture new connections.
Turning this off does not stop the proxy or delete past history. Turning it back on records only new connections, not existing streams.
Capture or storage may be incomplete · see History
Native capture holds up to 2,048 records. Android history retains up to 5,000 records and 8 MiB; finished records expire after 24 hours. Active records take priority. Limits do not stop forwarding.
A native eviction can happen before or after Android collects a record. These are events, not a count of distinct missing connections; some evictions may mean missing history.
Android history rotations: %1$d · older finished records removed by retention limits
Capture refusals · native: %1$d · Android: %2$d. Refusals can omit connections from history; forwarding is unaffected.
Unclassified events from older history: %1$d · their source and distinct missing connection count are unknown
Clears finished native, memory and saved history, and resets history event counters. Active records and their traffic accounting are preserved.
